title: Best Bookshelf (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected from PCMag, RTINGS, and CNET reviews that all discuss the IKEA SYMFONISK Bookshelf speaker.
assumptions: No price information was provided in the sources, so price is omitted.

verdict.line: Picture a living room where you want a discreet speaker that doubles as a shelf. The SYMFONISK delivers Wi‑Fi audio, Sonos Trueplay room‑correction, and AirPlay 2 support, making it ideal for multi‑room setups. Its main catch is that the bracket for wall mounting is sold separately.
